title: Passive & Anterior Pre-Nominal Participles (-t/-tt) with által

sections.title: Describing Completed Actions Before the Noun
sections.content: To describe a building or work of art through who designed it, when it was built, or how it was decorated, Hungarian uses the past/passive participle (-t/-tt) before the noun: az 1896-ban felavatott Iparművészeti Múzeum ('the Museum of Applied Arts inaugurated in 1896').

sections.title: Expressing the Agent with [Noun] + által + [-t/-tt Participle]
sections.content: Since Hungarian rarely uses passive main verbs in everyday sentences, the agentive postposition által ('by') thrives inside pre-nominal -t/-tt participial clauses: a Lechner Ödön által tervezett Postatakarékpénztár ('the Postal Savings Bank designed by Ödön Lechner').

sections.title: Agentive & Temporal -t/-tt Participial Modifiers
rows: a Lechner Ödön által tervezett épület
the building designed by Ödön Lechner
a Pártos Gyulával közösen megalkotott palota
the palace co-created with Gyula Pártos
the glass hall decorated with floral lines

items.spanish: A Lechner Ödön által tervezett Postatakarékpénztár a magyar szecesszió csúcspontja.
items.english: The Postal Savings Bank designed by Ödön Lechner is the pinnacle of the Hungarian Secession.

items.spanish: Az 1896-ban felavatott Iparművészeti Múzeum smaragdzöld kupolája messziről ragyog.
items.english: The emerald-green dome of the Museum of Applied Arts, inaugurated in 1896, shines from afar.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Keep the exact order: [Article] + [Agent + által] + [Adverbs/Cases] + [-t/-tt Participle] + [Head Noun], e.g. a Lechner által 1901-ben átadott épület.
